metadata.title: AI stack and frontier curriculum targeted audit
metadata.scope: This is a targeted JSON audit and proposed patch set. Broad S0-S17 competency stages and 12-stage N0-N11 job route are different alternatives; S7X/S16R/S18 remain conditional or beyond the requested S0-S17 boundary.

executive_summary.decision: Keep direct API routing and the paid-entry narrow path; pilot Gemini 3.8 Flash only for visual/video gaps and defer OpenCode Go until metered eligible coding spend justifies $10/month. Reallocate existing late-stage module time to six bounded patches if prerequisites pass.
executive_summary.largest_defensible_improvement: Transcript-first lecture indexing plus selective Gemini 3.8 visual review, independent correctness gates and lower overlap in frontier modules.
executive_summary.measurement_status: No model API benchmark, human time-saving study, curriculum gate or quality-per-dollar field trial was run.
executive_summary.important_constraint: 360 active weeks at 20 human study hours each is the narrow 7200-hour route; 37/42 scheduled AI hours do not certify human mastery or compress gates.

highlighted_goals.finding: Unmeasured; model costs alone cannot rank accepted quality.
Gemini is technically capable, but full daily raw video processing exceeds the low budget in static mode.
Retain a deployable service and independent programming evidence before optional frontier work.
Reuse existing RF/world-model/control/precision modules and their artifacts; no mandatory hour expansion.
Only promote a watchlist item after a baseline, held-out task, compute plan and falsifiable gate.
Keep Proton Mail/VPN, GitHub and Contabo allowances, 10% reserve and direct API caps.

priority: Latest explicit weekly human/AI tables of 15 October 2026
Narrow v53 weekly route for human scheduling
Broad v53.2 for topic inventory and stage ordering
v16/v14 for prior AI stack, not observed quality

conflicts.issue: Narrow reference has 20 human curriculum hours at 40-hour work or 15 at 45-hour work; latest employed state has 18 human core hours plus 42 AI agent-hours at 45-hour work.
conflicts.resolution: Model 18 human hours/week for employed progression; retain 20-hour week units as content, not elapsed calendar weeks. AI hours remain separate. 7200/18/46≈8.70 active-year equivalents before pauses and failed gates.

conflicts.issue: Broad 58452 hours and narrow 7200 hours describe different paths; summing them double-counts shared competencies.
conflicts.resolution: Keep narrow paid-entry path primary; broad serves as optional reference inventory and stage taxonomy.

conflicts.issue: Broad source also contains S7X, S16R and S18, while requested default stage range is S0-S17.
conflicts.resolution: Patch S0-S17 only; list special stages as optional conditional context, never an additional required semester.

conflicts.issue: v16 routes 70/30 of calls while the latest token budget specifies 70/30 baseline tokens plus 40% cheap extra.
conflicts.resolution: Use latest token accounting; do not convert call percentages into token shares or observed quality.

conflicts.issue: Earlier 67517-hour candidate and recovery patch ledger are not among currently inspected source files.
conflicts.resolution: Do not claim reconciliation to v55/A2 or count recovery hours from a checkpoint alone.

source_limitations: GitHub sx inaccessible through current connector; no repo writes or code inspection claimed.
Only primary entry pages for new educational links checked, not every lecture subtitle/chapter.
Provider account access, regional availability, invoiced VPS and tax/FX not confirmed.

model_benchmark_method_and_results.protocol: Freeze 30-60 representative tasks after collecting consent/licensing; stratify easy/medium/adversarial, compare incumbent A and alternatives B/C at equal budget and identical tool access, with held-out tasks and blinded human review.
model_benchmark_method_and_results.analysis: Paired task differences and task/week bootstrap CIs once actual observations exist. Report residuals by difficulty/domain, ablations for model versus retrieval/tool effects and out-of-sample calibration. No meaningful 1-3% accuracy claim is available.
model_benchmark_method_and_results.benchmark_leakage_control: Freeze task inputs and scorers; agent cannot edit hidden tests or grading criteria.

alternative_stacks.name: Direct APIs with established text routing
alternative_stacks.cost_basis: Baseline $75 no-job or $80 employed, 100k baseline tokens per agent-hour; no extra subscription
alternative_stacks.model_change: none; source-linked captions with cheap extraction

alternative_stacks.name: Bounded Gemini multimodal pilot
alternative_stacks.cost_basis: Replace 25% of curriculum-extra cheap tokens with Gemini 3.8 Flash, no added subscription; within current ceiling in the model
alternative_stacks.model_change: Gemini on genuinely visual/video tasks only, keep Haiku/Luna on text and DeepSeek on code

alternative_stacks.name: OpenCode Go coding quota
alternative_stacks.cost_basis: Additional $10/month reduces available direct API pool by $10 unless comparable paid coding calls are displaced
alternative_stacks.model_change: Replace eligible coding calls only; verify quota, data terms, quality and actual displaced spend

cost_per_accepted_deliverable.reason: No task acceptance and human repair log exists; provider prices and scheduled agent-hours do not identify denominator.
cost_per_accepted_deliverable.opencode_go_break_even: Requires at least $10/month in actually displaced eligible direct API coding spend at no worse accepted quality. Entire modeled cheap pool is only about $4.37 no-job or $4.95 employed; Go does not pay for itself from that pool alone.
cost_per_accepted_deliverable.note: A video-capable modality can still be worth its cost when a text-only route omits crucial visual information; fidelity is unmeasured.

routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.T0: Existing licensed captions/transcripts, timestamp index, retrieval and cheap source extraction; require source-linked claims.
routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.T1: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for bounded coding during published off-peak hours; Haiku/Luna for cheap text transforms. Use isolated worktree, tests and per-task budget.
routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.T1_multimodal_trial: Gemini 3.8 Flash direct API for a small set of visual lecture segments, diagrams or audio/video claims that captions miss. Compare against captions-only; count tokens before and after, use agentic video only when targeted queries justify it.
routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.T2: Sol/Sonnet/Argon/Spark for architecture, numerical reasoning, independent review and counterexamples; escalations by error/consequence.
routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.T3: Distinct verifier plus deterministic oracle for security-critical code, scientific claims and irreversibility; Opus/Wonder under a dollar cap when cheaper review fails.
fallbacks: When DeepSeek is peak, queue nonurgent coding or use pre-capped alternative; do not represent peak as off-peak.
When Gemini unavailable, use source captions and human-selected visual clips; no automatic substitution of TTS model.
When provider/model price or output reasoning changes, recompute before running long loops.
routing_escalation_and_fallbacks.security: No Contributor-mode submission of private sx repository content, private mail or unpublished product material without explicit compatible terms; sandbox untrusted snippets and isolate credentials.

curriculum_hour_and_collision_audit.route_rule: These are disjoint alternative routes; do not sum them as required workload and do not apply any patch without host-module lesson displacement.

narrow_nm54_shared_host.condition: Separate exercises and previously scheduled lessons displaced; these are proposals rather than time already recovered.

human_schedule.calendar_assumption: 46 active weeks/year yields 8.70 active-year equivalents before pauses, repetitions, and failed gates; other work and gym hours are distinct.

semester_patch_operations.reason_for_placement: S11 develops model-based RL; S15 applies learned dynamics to control. Narrow route NM54 has a direct world-model experiment.
semester_patch_operations.topic_and_competency: World model state, JEPA and action-conditioned control
semester_patch_operations.proposed_displacement_not_yet_approved: Replace a portion of generic self-play/world-model survey and repeated policy overview with one controlled dynamics experiment; exact lesson displacement requires review.
semester_patch_operations.source_hour_basis: Existing broad module hours from unified v53.2; narrow module hours from v53.1. Reallocations preserve each route's total if approved. No recovered-hour claim.
semester_patch_operations.reproducible_implementation: Small seeded simulator with classical state estimator, dynamics learner and policy; machine-readable trajectories and manifest.
semester_patch_operations.evaluation_protocol: Freeze action traces, randomized seeds and train/test worlds; compare open-loop prediction with closed-loop task success and object-state retention over 3 horizons; report failure types.
semester_patch_operations.quantitative_pass_fail_gate: Run all fixed-seed tests and a distinct held-out world; only claim an improvement when a paired confidence interval for task success excludes zero and no hard safety invariant fails. Otherwise mark exploratory.
semester_patch_operations.artifact_to_ship: Small seeded simulator with classical state estimator, dynamics learner and policy; machine-readable trajectories and manifest.
semester_patch_operations.career_transfer_justification: Dynamics evaluation transfers to serving reliability, robotics simulation and research reproducibility.
semester_patch_operations.availability_and_hardware_constraints: Simulation only; no requirement to train large video models or operate a robot.
semester_patch_operations.counting_rule: The same build/reproduction counts once inside the host module, not again as a separate capstone, product or AI-agent hour.
semester_patch_operations.nonoverlap_note: NM54 reserves a distinct eight-hour world-model dynamics exercise; P04 may use another eight hours in the 120-hour host module, with separate assessment and no shared clock time.

semester_patch_operations.reason_for_placement: S14-B already schedules chiplets and accelerator dataflow; N10 addresses architecture co-design.
semester_patch_operations.topic_and_competency: MX precision, chiplet link, backside power and transistor scaling

uncertainties_and_revalidation_triggers: Current provider prices/quotas should be checked at purchase and at Gemini/Argon promotional change dates.
The 100k tokens per agent-hour and 25% retry factors are sensitivity assumptions, not measured distributions.
End-to-end 10-video/day study throughput and retention need actual timestamped source fidelity and unaided comprehension checks.
Specific HEPA acronym remains unresolved; no silent JEPA substitution.
Curriculum's 14468 inherited base hours lack full ancestral line-item ledger, as disclosed in unified open_gap_register.
Private sx contents and current GitHub version are unavailable; inspect before applying code-facing patches.
Educational course entry-page availability does not prove every lecture has English subtitles.
RF FR3 is a research band label; actual local regulation and licensing must be checked before field work.

final_decision.stack: A baseline with a small, capped B multimodal evaluation using direct Google API only where captions miss technical visuals; DeepSeek off-peak remains volume coding route. No Go subscription until break-even observed.
final_decision.budget: $75/month unemployed or ~$80/month employed at illustrative 100k tokens/agent-hour; use $70 only if logged token intensity stays under its supported threshold.
final_decision.curriculum: Retain N0-N11 job path and broad S0-S17 as advanced reference. Offer P01-P06 as conditional within-module substitutions, with no new required hours. Keep QLAN, FR3 regulatory assumptions, multiplayer world models and speculative transistor scaling in watchlist unless resources and gates justify a specialist branch.
final_decision.recheck_after: 14 days of task- and provider-level token, repair and accepted-output logs; next model price transition.

rejection_of_further_increments.stack: Reject a new model/subscription unless marginal cost per accepted deliverable falls with equal or better source fidelity, security and review cost on held-out tasks.
rejection_of_further_increments.curriculum: Reject a new mandatory module until prerequisites, existing coverage, displaced hours, runnable artifact and independently scored gate all pass.
rejection_of_further_increments.statistics: No empirical quality interval, overfitting rate, 1-3% error bound, Bayesian best-plan probability or original-research superiority is claimed without observed data.
